gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis or recurrent supratentorial- or infra-tentorial glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) (World Health Organization 2016 or 2021)

candidate_evidence.quote: The Chimeric Antigen Receptors (CAR).B7-H3T cells will be administered via intraventricular infusion up to 3 weekly infusions.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Autologous CAR-T Cells Targeting B7-H3 in Recurrent or Refractory GBM CAR.B7-H3Tc

role_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to test the safety of using T lymphocyte chimeric antigen receptor cells against the B7-H3 antigen (CAR.B7-H3T cells) in patients with glioblastoma.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous B7-H3-directed CAR-T cell therapy, intraventricular
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: T lymphocyte chimeric antigen receptor cells against the B7-H3 antigen

coder_notes: cns5_terminology coded cns5 because the record cites WHO 2021 (also cites WHO 2016 and uses 'glioblastoma multiforme'; tie rule gives cns5). B7-H3 is the CAR target but is not stated as an entry requirement or measured biomarker, so no biomarker row. Prior temozolomide with RT is a prior-therapy requirement, not a study agent.
